$comment: Accepted dependency risks for scripts/ci/deps-audit.mjs. An entry exempts ONE advisory ID until `expires` (inclusive). Expired or missing entries for high/critical findings FAIL CI. Re-assess each entry before extending its expiry; prefer upgrading the dependency over extending.

allowlist.reason: Only exploitable when the caller passes a `buf` array to uuid v3/v5/v6. The app never calls uuid directly; transitive via @metamask/* utils inside the Privy/wagmi client bundle. No server-side sink.
DoS via malformed percent-encoding, reachable only through WalletConnect URI parsing of user-supplied connection strings in the client bundle. No server-side parsing path in app code.
toSSG() static-export helper inside @wagmi/connectors>porto (embedded-wallet connector, client-side). The app never calls hono's toSSG; no server-side sink.
parseBody() dot-notation nesting inside @wagmi/connectors>porto (client-side). The app never runs a hono server; no reachable sink.
Query-parser fragment handling inside @wagmi/connectors>porto (client-side). Same non-reachability assessment as the other hono entries.

ReDoS in fromDataURI. Transitive via @coinbase/cdp-sdk inside the Privy/wagmi wallet bundle (axios@1.19.0 nested). Zero imports of axios/coinbase/x402 in app|lib|components (verified grep); all server HTTP uses fetch/viem/supabase-js, never axios. Each advisory requires attacker-controlled input INTO axios (data: URLs, proxy/hostnames, form-data options, HTTP/2, redirect chains) — unreachable: the SDK calls fixed CDP endpoints. Forcing override risks breaking wallet signing flows unverifiable without E2E; reassess on SDK upgrade.
